video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Jabari Walker| 10.12.26

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on his increased comfort level playing the five position
quotes.excerpt: Obviously the jump shot opens it up. You want to be able to space the floor.
quotes.quote: Obviously the jump shot opens it up. You want to be able to space the floor. It is one of my advantages, so I think being more confident in my shot this year, I can space the floor a lot better and it just makes it easier for my teammates. I think I also got stronger and my mindset of just being more physical has helped with rebounding and a bunch of the physicality aspects at the five. It is definitely a different mindset.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker says he is focusing on floor spacing and physicality while playing the five this season. He believes being more confident in his jump shot will make things easier for his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the challenge of guarding centers like Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: There is a handful of fives in the league where you think about it the night before.
quotes.quote: There is a handful of fives in the league where you think about it the night before, like, oh damn, I got to go against him and I got to hit him early. And Mitchell Robinson is one of them. So to test that early, I think going in was just get him off the glass and if you look at how I did with that, I am happy with keeping him off the glass.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker admits Mitchell Robinson is one of the few centers he thinks about the night before a game. Walker says his main goal against Robinson was to keep him off the glass.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on why he respects LeBron James' leadership
quotes.excerpt: There is certain people when they talk it just makes sense. It is just straight to the point.
quotes.quote: There is certain people when they talk it just makes sense. It is just straight to the point and I think every time he says something it makes sense and it is, okay, I can get behind that. And then you just respect the body of work that he has done as well. So you know when he tells you something it is in the best interest for you or the team and it is just a common goal.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on LeBron James leadership style. He says when LeBron speaks it always makes sense and is straight to the point. You know when he tells you something it is in the best interest for you or the team.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the energy and impact of Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese is one of the hearts of the team, just the lively energy.
quotes.quote: Tyrese is one of the hearts of the team, just the lively energy. You cannot teach that. Just the way that when he has the ball, it makes people want to move around. He cuts, plays off the ball, is fast, and he is kind of the definition of how we want to play.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker calls Tyrese Maxey one of the hearts of the team. He says Maxey's energy is something you cannot teach and his play style is the definition of how the Sixers want to play.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on learning from LeBron James' vocal leadership
quotes.excerpt: I did not realize he was so vocal. Another guy when he talks you just want to listen.
quotes.quote: I did not realize he was so vocal. Another guy when he talks you just want to be quiet and just listen. It always makes sense. He is not talking just to talk. He is very direct, very meaningful, very impactful, and so he just commands a room. You see why LeBron is so respected and why he has done the things he has done.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker says he was surprised by how vocal LeBron James is in the locker room. He notes that LeBron does not talk just to talk and that he commands a room whenever he speaks.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on LeBron James' approach to team film sessions
quotes.excerpt: He always has a solution for everything. That is the way I feel.
quotes.quote: Usually when we are watching film, I think we will ask a question and then the room will just be like, we will think, and then LeBron is like, no, let us start off this way and do this and blah blah, just to build team camaraderie and earn each other's trust and then we will switch it up to this later on. I am like, that makes so much sense. He always has a solution for everything.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker shares insight into LeBron James approach during film sessions. Walker says LeBron always has a solution for everything and focuses on building team camaraderie and earning trust.
